_comment: Frozen from the tree of 2026-08-14 (main 43c1ec53) with
`bun run check:bloat --update-baseline`. Read scripts/check-bloat.ts for what
the two numbers mean and why this is a ratchet and not an absolute bar.
WHY 800 LINES. It is where the concentration shows up. 93 files out of 1.997
(4,7%) are over it, and those 93 hold 156.891 of the tree's 497.049 lines:
31,6% of the code sits in 4,7% of the files. Lower thresholds do not change
the shape, only the size of this file (>500: 169 files / 40,8%; >1200: 50
WHY 20 LINES FOR A CLONE. Twenty normalised lines is about a third of a
screen: nobody types that twice by accident. At 20 there are 15 groups and
426 redundant lines, and all 15 were opened and read. Raising the threshold
to 25 drops the count to 6 and loses genuine finds, among them the three
components that Editor/EditorTabs.tsx and Editor/FilePane.tsx hold byte for
byte (CopyPathBtn, WrapBtn, PreviewBtn).
WHY IT EXISTS AT ALL. In the night of 13-14/08/2026 the two biggest files of
client/src/components/Board produced three semantic conflicts across three
different merges: two branches renaming the same prop, two rewriting the same
state machine, two adding the same function under different names. Git merged
all three cleanly.
RAISING A NUMBER HERE is allowed, in the same commit as the change that grew
it, so the diff shows what the lines bought. Lowering one is free and the
gate asks for it out loud when a file gets cured.
2026-08-15: duplication was raised 368 -> 413 in the commit that added the
two new performance gates, and the two groups that did it are named here so
the number is not anonymous:
- scripts/check-drag-frames.ts <-> scripts/check-session-growth.ts (23 lines):
the CLI tail both gates share, differing only in the payload each writes
into its own baseline. Two callers is where extracting starts to pay, not
where it has already paid; the third gate of this shape is the one that
should force it.
- scripts/check-emdash.ts <-> scripts/check-ui-language.ts (22 lines): the
quote/comment/regex lexer, COPIED. This one is real debt and it is the
kind this repo has been bitten by: the copy's own comment cites a false
positive the original already had to fix, which is drift arriving before
the ink is dry. The two outputs differ today (emdash wants comments
blanked with strings kept, ui-language wants codeOnly plus a literal
table with offsets), so unifying them is a real refactor with both gates'
tests as the net, not a five-minute extraction. Named, not hidden.
2026-08-15, later: `client/src/lib/i18n-en.ts` (906) is the English half of the
translation catalogue, split out of `i18n.ts` so it stops riding in the eager
bundle (that split is what put `check:bundle` back inside its budget without
moving the budget). It is DATA: 900 lines of key-value pairs, and cutting a
dictionary at an arbitrary line number to satisfy a threshold meant for logic
would make it harder to read, not easier. Its sibling `i18n.ts` drops 2096 ->
1210 in the same move, which is the half of this edit that is free.

it. Measured on a clean tree at main 31f9bd306: the gate is already red there,
so the 26 lines landed with an earlier card that did not record them. Named,

- client/src/components/Layout/InsertDividers.tsx:71-102 <-> 168-195 (25

- client/src/components/Terminal/SingleTerminalPane.tsx:1060-1090 <->
These are three real extractions somebody owes; recording the number here is
what keeps the gate meaningful for everybody else in the meantime.
2026-09-09: task-dispatcher.test.ts is ratcheted for AGPT-03 model/effort
requeue, manual-model fallback, and fanout regressions. The stateful cases
share its dispatcher harness; moving them without a clean harness boundary
would hide their lifecycle assertions rather than reduce coupling.
2026-09-10: codex.ts grew for CODEX-02 thread persistence (resolveCodexInvocation,
thread.started capture, resume vs fresh argv branching). It mirrors the existing
claude_code_sessions pattern already living in claude-code.ts, so splitting it out
now would just move the coupling rather than remove it.

branch that records it (the keys of the browser tab sheet): the other +111 landed
on main after a8b151bb8 without being recorded, and they surfaced only because the
ten new keys pushed the file one line past its ceiling. Same day:
`tests/e2e/browser-tab-chrome.spec.ts` is new at 896 - the TOPIC-BROWSER-02
scenario extends the file that already defends the tab chrome and its site fixture,
instead of copying both into a second spec - and RemoteBrowserPanel.tsx is lowered

chip only when the hold changes), PR #64 (the board reads the e2e from the pull request CI: lane release,
off-lane admission, envelope rules) and PR #53 (agent control on the tab chrome). Each PR alone stayed inside

16/09, PR #55 (the terminal holds what you type until the reattach is proven):
SingleTerminalPane.tsx 1229 -> 1359. +121 are the queue itself wired into the pane (the
`TerminalInputQueue` instance, `markAttached`/`markDetached` around `replay-end`, the three input
doors routed through it, and the two bands); +9 are what the adversarial review bought: the loss
band now carries its CAUSE (`data-reason`) and withholds the invitation to retype until the attach
is back (`inputAttached` state, `data-retype`), because one sentence for three causes told a reader
whose 8 KB paste was refused on the spot that it `was too old to send`. i18n-it/en +5 each are the
three sentences plus the retype invitation as a string of its own, which is what makes it
withholdable. The other rows of this date arrived with main and were never recorded.
16/09, PR #46 (the address sheet no longer reopens by itself after leaving zoom):
`tests/e2e/pane-zoom.spec.ts` 1707 -> 1753 is LAYOUT-40, the scenario that leaves the
zoom and asserts the address sheet stays shut; it extends the spec that already owns
the zoom lifecycle instead of opening a second file with the same fixture.
`RemoteBrowserPanel.tsx` 1440 -> 1451 is the guard that reopens the sheet only on a
real user intent, not on the layout sync that follows the un-zoom. The other rows of
this date arrived with main and are recorded at main's sizes, not this branch's.
